_about: Models to generate with tools/meshy/meshy.py, in model-queue order (docs/art/model-queue.md). id = the game's id; kind = nodes or buildings; variants = name -> extra description (each variant is its own model). Optional prompt_suffix / texture_suffix override the shared style for one asset. Optional retired = a list of variant names made once and taken out of the game: they are never made, previewed or refined again.

assets.prompt: A tall Scots pine tree with a straight reddish-brown trunk, a bare lower trunk and a crown of layered dark-green needle clusters

variants.b: shorter and fuller, a younger tree
variants.c: wind-bent crown leaning slightly to one side

assets.prompt: A broad old European oak tree with a thick gnarled trunk and a wide rounded crown of dense green leaves

variants.b: a young oak with a narrower crown

assets.prompt: A date palm tree with a tall ringed trunk and a crown of long arching green fronds

variants.b: trunk curving gently to one side

assets.prompt_suffix: Desert oasis on the edge of the ancient world, natural and believable, realistic bark and fronds, warm sun-bleached palette. Game asset for a top-down real-time strategy game: one object standing on flat ground, clear readable silhouette, no base plate, no people, no text.
